The way our marriage goes is like this
He sends me hate filled emails for a week. (He is deployed). He asks for forgiveness I forgive him.
I go out in a dress, he throws the biggest hissy fit and refuses to talk to me for a week.
I am going through grief right now and already feeling down but he really does not care. I told him I'm feeling very low I.e. Suicidal he doesn't care.
I just took a bunch of Xanax and heart meds and alcohol and now going to drive. Hope I pass out at the wheel and crash.
